the MUSEUM?

I'm doing?
TEXT_PEWTERCITY_TRAINER_TIPS:
TRAINER TIPS Any POKéMON that
takes part in
battle, however
short, earns EXP!
TEXT_PEWTERCITY_YOUNGSTER:
You're a trainer
right? BROCK's
looking for new
challengers!
Follow me!
TEXT_PEWTERGYM_BROCK:
There are all
kinds of trainers
in the world! Some raise POKéMON
for fights. Some
see them as pets. I'm in training to
become a POKéMON
breeder. If you take your
POKéMON training
seriously, go
visit the GYM in
CERULEAN and test
your abilities!
TEXT_PEWTERGYM_COOLTRAINER_M:
Stop right there,
kid! You're still light
years from facing
BROCK!
TEXT_PEWTERGYM_GYM_GUIDE:
Hiya! I can tell
you have what it
takes to become a
POKéMON champ! I'm no trainer,
but I can tell
you how to win! Let me take you
to the top!
TEXT_PEWTERMART_CLERK:
Hi there!
May I help you?
TEXT_PEWTERMART_SUPER_NERD:
Good things can
happen if you
raise POKéMON
diligently, even
the weak ones!
TEXT_PEWTERMART_YOUNGSTER:
A shady old man
got me to buy
this really weird
fish POKéMON! It's totally weak
and it cost ¥500!
TEXT_PEWTERNIDORANHOUSE_MIDDLE_AGED_MAN:
Our POKéMON's an
outsider, so it's
hard to handle. An outsider is a
POKéMON that you
get in a trade. It grows fast, but
it may ignore an
unskilled trainer
in battle! If only we had
some BADGEs...
TEXT_PEWTERPOKECENTER_COOLTRAINER_F:
POKéMON CENTERS
are wonderful! They heal POKéMON
completely. Even conditions
like sleep, burn,
poison and others
are cured.
TEXT_PEWTERPOKECENTER_GENTLEMAN:
What!? TEAM ROCKET is
at MT.MOON? Huh?
I'm on the phone! Scram!
TEXT_PEWTERPOKECENTER_NURSE:
Welcome to our
POKéMON CENTER! We heal your
POKéMON back to
perfect health!
TEXT_PEWTERSPEECHHOUSE_GAMBLER:
POKéMON learn new
techniques as
they grow! But, some moves
must be taught by
the trainer!
TEXT_PEWTERSPEECHHOUSE_YOUNGSTER:
POKéMON become
easier to catch
when they are
hurt or asleep! But, it's not a
sure thing!

you drive your
POKéMON too hard,
they'll dislike
you. You should take a
rest.

POKéMON MART. It's a convenient
shop, so please
visit us in
VIRIDIAN CITY. I know, I'll give
you a sample!

along the road? It's a bit scary,
but you can jump
from them. You can get back
to PALLET TOWN
quicker that way.

trainers are
allowed through. You don't have the
BOULDERBADGE yet!

LEAGUE has many

dawdling and get
a move on!

more practice! But hey, you know
that! I'm out of
here. Smell ya!

contest trainers! You just earned a
fabulous prize!

raising POKéMON. I should release
